Name: Bright and Fun Artifact and Dig Spots for Alternative Textures
Author: DozyDew
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DhPfJjV.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vmEP8rK.gif[/img]     [img]https://i.imgur.com/KWh6WbH.gif[/img]      [img]https://i.imgur.com/67gCOoF.gif[/img]      [img]https://i.imgur.com/tnizcYG.gif[/img]      [img]https://i.imgur.com/mWsC9Hj.gif[/img]       [img]https://i.imgur.com/HKjnEeQ.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[size=6]﻿[/size][/center][size=3]
[font=Tahoma]This mod p[/font][font=Tahoma]rovides a variety of retexture options for artifact spots (aka, dig spots) via the Alternative Textures mod for Stardew Valley. The [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [/b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mods are requirements for this mod to work. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]is also recommended.

Please see the links to guides at the bottom of this description section for guides on changing the default texture.
[/font][center][/center][/size]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/gC1tY46.png[/img][/center]

[font=Tahoma][size=3]HOW TO CHANGE THE DEFAULT TEXTURE:
[/size][/font]The default texture for artifact spots will show as the first texture "texture_0.png" (Dark Cloud) unless changed via change the file name (method 1), or by using the Generic Mod Config Menu (method 2) to deselect all but the desired texture. Visual guides for each method are linked below.

[size=3][url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DozyDew/Bright-and-Fun-Artifact-Spots/main/Change%20Default1.png]METHOD 1: VISUAL GUIDE FOR MANUALLY CHANGING THE DEFAULT TEXTURE[/url]
[url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DozyDew/Bright-and-Fun-Artifact-Spots/main/Change-Default-2-Generic-Mod-Config-Menu.jpg]METHOD 2: VISUAL GUIDE FOR USING THE GENERIC MOD CONFIG MENU TO CHANGE DEFAULT TEXTURE[/url][/size]
